searchText: Steth price rose to peg it’s crazy 😅 why crazy, I think it was inevitable but selling doesn't actually reduce the number of eth of staked by lido, it just swaps some new depositors There should be a significant discount accounting for both time spent locked and risk of lido default. When I bought it it was 5-8%. What’s the point of holding steth when you can just hold eth 😅 no there should be no discount it should trade at ~1 because you can go out and because it has uses as collateral That’s not how finance works. Risk leads to a discount. If lido rugs or has issues that can cost you your eth and those are more likely than the eth network itself failing. yet lido was at 1 until massive dumps from luna collapse, then celsius fud, then the discount from the ethpow fork. now all that is gone and it trades at ~1 in fact, if you're right that the discount *should* exist, you can borrow steth on euler and short it I thought stETH should trade at a premium (>1 eth) post withdrawals because it accounts for the revenue to each eth deposited and earned by the validators? So <1 eth pre merge to account for the risk of merge. ~1 post merge and pre withdrawals to account for risk of withdrawals not happening. And >1 post withdrawals with a negligible or at least non measurable discount for rug pull/smart contract risk you can always deposit new eth at 1 That’s wsteth I believe We will *start* talking about it once ACD calls resume (in a couple weeks I think?).
